mutt: A mixed-breed dog standing, a medium honest mongrel of no particular breed: a moderate build with a deep chest and straight legs, a MEDIUM-LENGTH TAPERED MUZZLE that belongs to no pedigree, ONE EAR STANDING HALF UP AND THE OTHER FOLDING OVER, a short scruffy coat patched in tan, white and black, and a long tail with a slight upward curve. Bright friendly brown eyes.
pitbull: An American pit bull terrier standing, a compact heavily muscled medium dog with a BROAD DEEP CHEST, thick neck and short glossy coat. Its head is BROAD AND BLOCKY WITH PRONOUNCED CHEEK MUSCLES and a MODERATE-LENGTH SQUARE MUZZLE with a clear step up to the forehead. Its ears are natural, small and folded forward at the tip. Fawn coat with a white chest blaze, a long tapering tail.
beardeddragon: A bearded dragon standing on all fours, a broad flattened lizard in sandy tan and cream with a wide triangular head. Its body and flanks are edged with ROWS OF SOFT SPIKY SCALES, and beneath its chin hangs the feature that names it: a LOOSE POUCH OF SKIN COVERED IN LONG POINTED SPINES, held partly puffed so it flares below the jaw like a spiky beard. Long tapering tail.
cornsnake: A corn snake in a loose open curve, a slender smooth-scaled snake with a narrow head barely wider than its neck and round pupils. Its pattern is the point: LARGE ROUNDED ORANGE-RED SADDLE BLOTCHES EACH OUTLINED IN CRISP BLACK run down a warm orange back, with smaller matching blotches along the flanks, and its underside is a bold BLACK-AND-WHITE CHEQUERBOARD.
leopardgecko: A leopard gecko standing on all fours, a stout ground gecko in creamy yellow SPRINKLED ALL OVER WITH SMALL DISTINCT BLACK-BROWN SPOTS, with a broad triangular head and fine bumpy skin. Two features identify it: it HAS PROPER MOVABLE EYELIDS that can close, and its TAIL IS THICK, FAT, SEGMENTED AND BANDED, swollen with stored fat and nearly as wide as its body. Simple clawed toes, no sticky pads.
russiantortoise: A Russian tortoise walking, a SMALL tortoise with a LOW ROUNDED ALMOST CIRCULAR SHELL seen from above, coloured olive-tan to yellow-brown with irregular dark brown blotches on each plate. Its head is blunt with a hooked upper jaw and dark eyes, its skin is dull yellow-brown, and its stubby forelegs each carry FOUR CLAWS rather than five.
alaotragrebe: An Alaotra grebe swimming, a SMALL compact diving bird sitting low in the water with a rounded body and almost no visible tail. Its neck and upper breast are a deep RICH CHESTNUT-RED, its crown and back are dark blackish-grey, and its cheeks are pale silvery grey. It has a SHORT STRAIGHT POINTED DARK BILL and bright pale yellow eyes.
bachmanswarbler: A Bachman's warbler, a SMALL slim songbird with a fine pointed slightly downcurved black bill. The adult male is BRIGHT LEMON-YELLOW ON THE FACE, THROAT AND UNDERPARTS with olive-green upperparts, a GREY-BLACK CAP over the crown, and the marking that identifies it: a SOLID BLACK BIB COVERING THE UPPER BREAST just below the yellow throat.
christmasislandforestskink: A Christmas Island forest skink, a small slender ground skink with smooth glossy overlapping scales, short legs and a long tapering tail. Its back is warm chocolate-brown, and TWO NARROW CLEAN PALE CREAM STRIPES RUN THE LENGTH OF ITS BODY, one along each side from behind the eye to the base of the tail, bordered below by a darker band. Small dark eyes, a blunt snout.
littlemarianafruitbat: A little Marianas fruit bat sitting upright with its wings folded close to its body, a SMALL flying fox with dense dark chocolate-brown fur and a PALER GOLDEN-BROWN MANTLE across its shoulders and neck. Its face is DOG-LIKE with a long muzzle, large dark eyes and SIMPLE SMALL POINTED EARS with no ornament. Its folded wings are thin dark leathery skin.
roundislandburrowingboa: A Round Island burrowing boa, a SLENDER snake of moderate length lying in a loose open curve, its head only slightly wider than its neck with a POINTED SNOUT and small dark eyes. Its scales are strongly KEELED, each carrying a raised central ridge so the skin looks matte and rough, and it is patterned in pale orange-brown mottled with darker olive blotches, paler beneath.
tecopapupfish: A Tecopa pupfish, a TINY stout deep-bodied desert fish only about the length of a thumb, with a rounded snout, an upturned mouth, LARGE ROUND EYES and rounded fins. The breeding male is a brilliant IRIDESCENT STEEL-BLUE over the head and flanks with a dark bar at the base of the tail, and a fine dark edge along the tail fin.
